recipientsInfo.heading: How recipients are determined
recipientsInfo.intro2: tab has one or more recipient types. When sending, each type resolves to concrete email addresses or in-app notifications:
recipientsInfo.descPrimaryContact: The customer's active primary contact on the order/invoice; without a primary contact this falls back to the customer's general email address.
recipientsInfo.descCommunicationRule: Uses the communication rules configured per customer (which contact receives which type of message). Managed on the customer record itself — see the link below.
recipientsInfo.descPermission: Every active user who has the chosen permission, regardless of which role contains it.
recipientsInfo.descRole: Every active user in a role with the given template role code.
recipientsInfo.descEmail: One fixed email address, independent of users or customers (e.g. a shared mailbox).
recipientsInfo.descDriver: The driver of the order, or — for HR events — the employee involved.
recipientsInfo.outro1: Per-customer communication rules (which customer contact receives which type of email) are managed on the customer record, tab
